title: Apollo 12 ALSEP
tagline: Eight years of listening in the Ocean of Storms.
kicker: A true story from the Moon · 1969 to 1977
mystery: What did a little science station hear on the Moon for eight years?
p1.dark: I begin in the dark, folded up inside a moon lander.
p1.rocket: Under me waits a Saturn V rocket. Hold on tight!
p1.gone: Five days later, two astronauts land on the Moon. With me on board.
p2.where: Ocean of Storms, the Moon. 19 November 1969.
p2.warm: Warmth! A rod of plutonium slides into my generator.
p2.power: Its heat turns into 70 watts of electricity. I'm awake!
p2.name: I am ALSEP. A science station, built to stay behind and listen.
p3.intrepid: That's Intrepid, the lander that carried me here.
p3.crew: Pete Conrad and Alan Bean: the third and fourth people to walk on the Moon.
p3.tv: Oops! Their TV camera was pointed at the Sun. It never worked again.
p4.cables: Six instruments, joined to me by cables. Let's switch them on!
p4.hint: Hold the button to switch on each instrument.
p4.s.seis: It feels the ground shake. Moonquakes, here I come!
p4.s.mag: It measures the Moon's magnetic field.
p4.s.wind: It catches tiny particles streaming from the Sun.
p4.s.gauge: It measures the Moon's very, very thin air.
p4.s.dust: It measures dust, and how hot it gets.
p4.s.ions: It counts tiny charged particles called ions.
p4.win: All on! My antenna points at Earth, and Earth can hear me.
p5.cousin: Look over there. It's Surveyor 3, a robot that landed in April 1967.
p5.close: Intrepid landed about 180 m from it. A pinpoint landing!
p5.parts: The astronauts walked over and took its camera and scoop home.
p5.why: About 10 kg of parts, to learn what years on the Moon do to machines.
p6.time: 20 November 1969. After 31 hours 31 minutes on the Moon…
p6.stay: Intrepid's bottom half was their launch pad. It stays here with me.
p6.alone: Now it's just me. Time to listen.
p7.plan: Up in orbit, the empty lander is let go. It will crash about 60 km away.
p7.hint: Watch the line. Tap RECORD while it shakes.
p7.calm: Not yet. That's just me humming!
p7.win: Recorded! The first artificial moonquake ever measured.
p7.science: Shaking tells scientists what the inside of the Moon is like.
p8.home: The astronauts flew home. I stayed and kept listening.
p8.goal: How long did I keep watch?
p8.win: 68,928 hours. That's 2,872 days, nearly eight years!
p8.decay: My plutonium slowly cooled: 70 watts at first, 63.5 after one year.
p9.date: 30 September 1977. Earth switched off all the ALSEP stations.
p9.still: Intrepid's bottom half is still here beside me.
p9.bye: Look up at the Moon tonight, and say hello to me.
